title: Everyday Pay Card Instant Cashouts — Cartwise Shopper Payouts Desk Reference
content:
An Everyday Pay Card plan of Cartwise Shopper Payouts lets a shopper cash out unpaid earnings instantly onto the shopper's own Everyday Pay Card. When a shopper on one of the card plans (Everyday Pay Card Blue, Gold, Platinum or Diamond) asks for such a cashout, the amount that goes onto the card is worked out under the company's rule for card cashouts, and the cashout is booked as an instant cashout entry on the shopper's payout account, dated the day it is made, together with a cashout fee entry of 0.00, because card plans charge no cashout fee.

## What this desk entry governs

| Item | Position on Cartwise Shopper Payouts |
|---|---|
| Request it answers | A shopper's request for an instant cashout onto the Everyday Pay Card |
| Result governed | The amount loaded onto the card by that cashout |
| Entries booked | One instant cashout entry, numbered in sequence among that day's cashouts, and one cashout fee entry at 0.00 |
| Effect on the account | The unpaid earnings balance falls by the amount loaded |
| Who runs it | The shopper, as the customer themselves |

## 1. Use and capability

`cash_out_to_card_075a5c73` books one instant cashout of a stated amount from the shopper's unpaid earnings onto the shopper's own Everyday Pay Card. In one call it records the instant cashout entry, numbered in sequence among the day's cashouts, records its cashout fee entry at 0.00, and lowers the unpaid earnings balance shown on the payout account by the amount. The tool books the amount it is given; it does not work the amount out.

## 2. How it is invoked

The tool belongs to the shopper. The agent unlocks `cash_out_to_card_075a5c73` and hands it over, and the customer themselves (the shopper) runs it on the shopper's own payout account with the values the agent states.

## 3. Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `payout_account_id` | The shopper payout account number the cashout is drawn from, as the agent reads it out from the payout account lookup | Identifier, as shown on the account |
| `amount_usd` | The amount loaded onto the card | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places (cents), as the agent states it; booked exactly as given |

The tool takes no fee parameter: its fee entry is always booked at 0.00.

## 4. Return

On success the tool returns a receipt with:

- `status` — `cashed_out` when the cashout was booked;
- `payout_event_id` — the reference number of the instant cashout entry;
- `fee_event_id` — the reference number of its 0.00 fee entry;
- `cashout_number` — the whole-number sequence of this cashout within the day;
- `amount_usd` — the amount loaded, USD with 2 decimal places;
- `event_date` — the booking date, written YYYY-MM-DD;
- `available_balance_usd` — the unpaid earnings balance left, USD with 2 decimal places.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A hypothetical call on account number PA-0001 with `amount_usd` 125.40 returns `status` `cashed_out`, a `cashout_number` of 1 if it is the first instant cashout booked on that account that day, an `amount_usd` of 125.40 and an `available_balance_usd` that is 125.40 lower than the balance shown before the call.
